description.value:
Always on (automated): +1 to Medicine and First Aid checks.

Action (once per scene): spend your Action on this technique; your next Medicine and First Aid check this scene gains a further +2.

Treatment (automated): use the item on a creature within reach to roll 1d6+1 healing; press Apply Healing on the Chat Card.

Reskin freely as training, a perk, an implant, a technique, a gadget or a power.
